# rmw_zenoh QoS chunk fixtures

Golden output of the real `rmw_zenoh_cpp` C++ functions `liveliness::Entity::make`, `qos_to_keyexpr` and `keyexpr_to_qos`, built from rmw_zenoh commit `dda52d6`. The tests read these files and never recompute an expected value. The program that produced the files is not part of this repository. The grid file `qos_grid.tsv` keeps 2 of the 4 columns that program printed (the profile fields and the chunk).

**📚 [Full Documentation](https://zettascalelabs.github.io/hiroz/)**
